content.title: Coinbase poised to gain from Wall Street's adoption of tokenization
content.description:
Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase Global (COIN) stock is boosted after beating third quarter estimates on the top and bottom lines. Citizens Director of Financial Technology Research Devin Ryan discusses the crypto trading platform's transaction growth, especially as more firms lean into asset tokenization.

Also catch Yahoo Finance's full interview with Coinbase CFO Alesia Haas, where she highlights the platform's next steps to becoming the "everything exchange."

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
